title: ML Engineer
description:
Job Description – Machine Learning Engineer (ML Engineer)

**Position:** Machine Learning Engineer  
**Experience:** Fresher – 1 Year  
**Location:** Coimbatore

Job Summary

We are seeking a passionate Machine Learning Engineer to develop, train, and deploy machine learning models that solve real\-world business problems. The ideal candidate should have a strong foundation in Python, Machine Learning algorithms, data analysis, and model development.

Key Responsibilities

* Design, develop, and deploy Machine Learning models.
* Collect, clean, and preprocess large datasets.
* Train, test, and optimize ML models for performance and accuracy.
* Analyze data and derive actionable insights.
* Work closely with AI, development, and business teams.
* Monitor and improve model performance in production.
* Implement and maintain data pipelines.
* Document model architectures, experiments, and results.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of **Python**.
* Understanding of **Machine Learning Algorithms** and concepts.
* Experience with **Scikit\-learn, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch**.
* Knowledge of **Data Preprocessing** and **Feature Engineering**.
* Experience with **Pandas, NumPy, and Matplotlib**.
* Understanding of statistics and probability concepts.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of Deep Learning and Neural Networks.
* Familiarity with NLP and Generative AI concepts.
* Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS.
* Knowledge of Git and version control systems.
* Understanding of MLOps concepts is an added advantage.

Pay: ₹15,000\.00 \- ₹18,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Pricing & CPQ - Analyst 2
description:
**Job Title \- Pricing \& CPQ \- Analyst \- ACS SONG**

**Management Level: Level 11 \- Analyst**

**Location: Kochi, Coimbatore, Trivandrum, Bangalore, Mumbai, Hyderabad, Chennai, Ahmedabad**

**Must have skills: PROS Smart Price Optimization**

**Good to have skills: Pricing Tools**

**Experience: 2\-3 years of experience is required**

**Educational Qualification: Graduation (Accurate educational details should capture)**

**Job Summary**


Results\-driven CPQ Pricing Analyst with 2–3 years of hands\-on experience implementing and optimizing CPQ solutions across mid\-size to enterprise organizations. Skilled in platforms such as PROS CPQ with a strong focus on pricing strategy, product configuration, discounting rules, and quote\-to\-cash automation. Adept at collaborating with cross\-functional teams—sales, finance, product, and IT—to gather business requirements, design scalable solutions, and deliver accurate, efficient quoting processes.

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**

* Provide functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools solutions like PriceFx, CONGA, PROS , SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus
* Build robust pricing models using advanced analytics and artificial intelligence to track key pricing KPIs, and build leadership dashboards in visualization tools.
* Work on assessing pricing processes in alignment with business imperatives and client’s sales strategy through client data diagnostics and gap analysis including current state assessment and future state design, Vendor assessment and selection.
* Work on designing and implementing pricing waterfall, pricing strategy, competitive pricing, pricing elasticity, margin analysis, pricing diagnostics, pricing catalog, and contract pricing of services, leading to a positive impact on topline and bottom line for global B2B organizations
* Work on B2B Pricing Analytics (Exploratory Analysis \& Reporting), target state analytics recommendation
* Work on recommending and deploying process improvements and enablers with best\-in\-class KPIs
* Work as an integral part of the client’s sales organization, towards driving efficient and effective structure pricing and discounting approach.
* You will work closely with our clients as Consulting Professionals who design, build, and implement strategies that can help enhance business performance within the Pricing \& CPQ area.
* The candidate will be responsible for providing functional and implementation support for Pricing and CPQ Tools

  

**Professional and Technical Skills:**

* 2\-3 years of progressive industry and/or consulting experience in the Products/ Communications \& High Tech/ Financial Services industry/ Resources
* Experience working with PROS Smart Price Optimization \& Management (POM) \& Smart Configure Price Quote (CPQ). Certification in these areas is an advantage.
* Functional experience in Pricing of Services, products, parts, and post sales services
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Macro, and PowerPoint and exposure to Visualization Tools such as Power BI and Tableau
* Knowledge of other Pricing \& CPQ tools like PriceFx, CONGA, SFDC CPQ, Zilliant, PROS, Vendavo, SAP/Oracle Pricing, Callidus are a plus

**Additional Information**

* Nice to have certification in any one of the following or equivalent from other pricing/CPQ solutions
* PROS Smart Price Optimization and Management  

PROS Smart Configure Price Quote

description:

* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams for data collection and analysis
* Provide actionable insights to support business growth and decision\-making
* Monitor KPIs and performance metrics across departments
* Improve efficiency through process optimization and automation
* Requirements:
* 8–12 years of experience in MIS / Data Management
* Strong experience in team handling and leadership
* Post Graduate in M.Sc. Data Analyst/ any related discipline
* Mandatory knowledge of latest MIS tools and technologies
* Strong expertise in using advanced AI tools for data analysis, automation, reporting, decision making and to enhance analytical and business outcomes.
* (e.g., Advanced Excel, Power BI, Tableau, ERP systems)
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management abilities
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, target\-driven environment

title: Back Office Operations Executive
description:
**Back Office Operations Executive**  
Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu \| Work from Office  
Shift Timing: Day Shift (Open to Night Shift)  
Department: Operations

**About the Role**  
We're hiring a Back Office Operations Executive who's quick, adaptable, and comfortable working with technology and data. You'll handle day\-to\-day operational tasks, work with spreadsheets and online tools, troubleshoot issues independently, and support internal processes efficiently.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Handle day\-to\-day back\-office and operational activities with speed and accuracy
* Work with Google Sheets, Google Workspace, and other online tools
* Use AI tools like ChatGPT, Claude, etc. to boost productivity and solve operational tasks
* Identify issues, troubleshoot, and find practical solutions independently
* Maintain and update data, records, sheets, and operational trackers
* Learn new tools, processes, and workflows quickly
* Complete assigned tasks within timelines while maintaining accuracy
* Coordinate with internal teams as required
* Support other operational needs as they come up

**What We're Looking For**

* Good working knowledge of Google Sheets \& Google Workspace
* Comfortable using AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, etc.
* Fast learner, able to work quickly and efficiently
* Strong problem\-solving and logical thinking
* Good attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities
* Familiarity with Shopify is a plus
* Willingness to work day shifts, open to night shifts (from office)
* Good communication skills and a proactive approach

Someone who's quick, tech\-friendly, curious, and enjoys figuring things out — comfortable with AI and online tools, and ready to take ownership of getting things done.
